en.title: This Lizard's First Meal Is Truly Strange. Can You Name It?
en.description: These are spiny-tailed lizards (Uromastyx). Hatchlings eat their mother's feces as a first meal to build gut flora, they swing a spiked tail at attackers, and they get most of their water from the plants they eat.
